Head coach and founder

Deng Awak

Talata Men, and on the floor with every team in the club

  • Captained Mount Royal University in Calgary, U SPORTS Canada West
  • Pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark
  • Has coached in four countries: Canada, Lithuania, Indonesia and Denmark
  • Founded Talata in 2021, from twenty players to more than 110
coach@talatabasketball.dk

Playing

Deng grew up in Alberta, Canada. He played university basketball at Mount Royal University in Calgary from 2012 to 2015 and captained the team in U SPORTS Canada West.

  • Vancouver Dragons, Canada, 2017 and 2018
  • Raseiniai, Lithuania, 2019
  • BK Amager, Basketligaen, Denmark, 2021 and 2022
  • Talata Men, Copenhagen. 34 points in the overtime cup win over Hørsholm, September 2026
Basketligaen highlights, 2021/22BK Amager. Watch on YouTube Mount Royal highlights, 2015Calgary. Watch on YouTube

More game film on Deng's YouTube channel.

Coaching

Deng has coached in Canada, Lithuania, Indonesia and Denmark.

  • Assistant coach at Mount Royal University, 2016
  • Player development at Kauno Žalgiris youth and Sostinės krepšinio mokykla in Vilnius
  • Built and ran the basketball academy at The British School of Vilnius
  • Assistant coach at Douglas College, Canada, 2021
  • Head coach at the University of Copenhagen, 2022
  • Assistant coach at RANS in the Indonesian Basketball League
  • Founder and head coach of Talata Basketball, Copenhagen, since 2021

At Talata

Deng started Talata in Copenhagen in 2021 with camps, and the club has had competitive teams since 2024. He coaches Talata Men and is in the gym with every team, from Mini to the Academy. This summer he took players to camps in Lethbridge, Canada and Nida, Lithuania.

This December he runs the NBA and EuroLeague Pathway Camp with guest coach Tremaine Dalton, and the Coaches Clinic for coaches from other clubs.
